## Ceramic Fabric Analysis at the Fictional Site of Kalimba Hollow

**Authors:** A. Placeholder and B. Example (Institute of Synthetic Studies)

### Abstract

We report portable X-ray fluorescence (pXRF) analysis of 120 ceramic sherds
from Kalimba Hollow, a fictional site invented for harness testing. We
identify three fabric groups and argue for two production sources.

### Methods

Analyses were run in R 4.3.2. Compositional groups were derived by principal
component analysis followed by k-means clustering. All analysis scripts were
written by the authors.

### Data availability statement

The pXRF measurement dataset is deposited on Zenodo under DOI
10.5281/zenodo.0000000 (CC BY 4.0), with DataCite metadata. Analysis code is
available at https://github.com/example/kalimba-hollow-analysis; no licence
file is stated in the repository. Supplementary Table S1 (sherd catalogue)
accompanies the article on the publisher's website.
